goal: Prevents a local attacker from hijacking or disabling a node's Tor onion service via injected control commands
Protects operators running -listenonion by validating Tor replies and cached keys before use
reviewability: Needs rebase: open merge conflict makes the branch stale even though review feedback is addressed
Substantive comments are already resolved, so reviewing the logic now is still worthwhile
agreement: Strong support after a demonstrated exploit was fixed and validated (jeanpablojp)
Concrete design suggestion adopted: strict positive validation over blacklisting (vasild)
Nonblocking suggestion about file permissions concluded unnecessary (winterrdog, vasild)

categories.name: p2p
why: P2 because it closes a real local command-injection path into the Tor control protocol
Benefit is confined to node operators running -listenonion, not the general node population
Demonstrated exploit shows concrete harm: hijacked onion connections with no log warning
